research.edition: international Close CRM REST API at api.close.com
research.searchCoverage: Official Close REST API at https://api.close.com/api/v1 with HTTP Basic api_key:. GET /me/ is the pinned credential validator and is used as healthcheck. GET /lead/ and GET /contact/ are cheap authenticated reads. Dated 2026-09-13 incident search found no qualifying unresolved Close CRM compromise after excluding Beacon CRM and Salesforce/Klue headlines.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /me/ from the pinned validator rather than GET /lead/?_limit=1.
Native Basic auth uses http.auth.basic with the API key as username and an empty password, matching official Authorization: Basic base64(api_key + ':') and pinned Buffer.from(`${apiKey}:`).
Native category is crm (source Productivity/Marketing are not both in Rust CATEGORIES; Close is a CRM).
The upstream user-agent is not sent. Trailing slashes on Close collection and member paths are retained.
GET /lead/ with optional _limit (1-100) and _skip. _fields comma-join from includeFields is omitted because native cannot compute joined query values.
Returns raw Close JSON under data rather than the pinned {leads, hasMore} wrapper.
GET /lead/{leadId}/ with URL-encoded path segment and trailing slash. includeFields/_fields omitted.
Returns raw Close JSON under data rather than the pinned {lead} wrapper.
GET /contact/ with optional _limit, _skip, and lead_id. includeFields omitted.
Returns raw Close JSON under data rather than the pinned {contacts, hasMore} wrapper.
GET /contact/{contactId}/ with URL-encoded path segment and trailing slash.
Returns raw Close JSON under data rather than the pinned {contact} wrapper.
Maps to documented GET /me/. Returns the raw Close user object under data.
POST /lead/ with name and optional description, url, and status_id. Nested contacts are omitted so the body stays a flat JSON object.
PUT /lead/{leadId}/ is a documented non-destructive patch. Unset optional fields are omitted from the body.
DELETE /lead/{leadId}/. Native result is {deleted, id} rather than the raw Close body so 200 and 204 share one contract.
POST /contact/ requires lead_id. Emails and phones stay omitted because native JSON bodies cannot encode nested arrays of objects here.
PUT /contact/{contactId}/ patches name and title.
GET /opportunity/ with optional _limit, _skip, and lead_id.
GET /opportunity/{opportunityId}/ with a trailing slash.
POST /opportunity/ requires lead_id. Value is integer cents matching Close.
PUT /opportunity/{opportunityId}/ patches status, value, confidence, and note.
GET /task/ with optional _limit, _skip, and lead_id.
GET /task/{taskId}/ with a trailing slash.
POST /task/ requires lead_id, text, and date. _type defaults to lead on the provider.
GET /activity/ lists mixed activity types with optional lead_id pagination.
GET /activity/{activityId}/ fetches one activity of any subtype.
POST /activity/note/ creates a note activity on a lead.
GET /custom_activity_type/ lists organization custom activity types.
EventOnly webhook. Close POSTs object_type=lead action=created. sideEffect is read because EventOnly ops do not mutate the provider.
EventOnly webhook for lead.updated.
EventOnly webhook for lead.deleted.
EventOnly webhook for contact.created.
EventOnly webhook for contact.updated.
EventOnly webhook for opportunity.created.
EventOnly webhook for opportunity.updated.
EventOnly webhook for activity.opportunity_status_change created.
EventOnly webhook covering activity.*.created events.
EventOnly webhook for task.created.
EventOnly webhook for task.completed.
